descricao: Day: When the sun is in the sky, temperatures reach 70 degrees Celsius, being fatal to human life.The only way to counteract this is to take refuge in the ruins that can be found in the place, which seem to have special properties. Night: The night is just as deadly, with temperatures dropping to -30 degrees Celsius, which will lead to hypothermia from not being well equipped. Just like in the day, the ruins can be used as safe points, because they have heat preservation properties.
